name: Bobwave
subtitle: Swinging wave music puzzle
shortDescription: Tune a row of glass beads on silver wire, release them, and catch the instant they all ring inside their ghost rings.
longDescription:
Bobwave is a pendulum puzzle played like an instrument. A row of glowing glass beads hangs on silver wire, and every level shows a ghost ring for each bead. Set how long each wire is, tap Release, and at the snap moment time freezes: every bead sitting inside its ring chimes. Read the ripple, retune, and release again until the whole wave locks into a chord.

Shorter wires swing faster, so the skill is in reading the pattern rather than in quick fingers. There are no timers and no lives, and trying again costs nothing.

### What Is Inside
- 120 hand-tuned levels, checked by a solver so every one can be solved, from two beads to a dozen.
- A new Daily Wave every day, the same for everyone, with a result you can share.
- A Sandbox where twelve beads play a generative melody you can loop.
- Three stars per level for clean, thoughtful solutions, plus hints when you are stuck.
- Glass-bell sound, long-exposure light trails and haptic ticks as you tune.
- Plays offline with no account. Reduced motion, VoiceOver support and nine languages.
